## Description

Generates profile likelihood confidence intervals
for standardized regression coefficients (beta) and other effect sizes,
including multiple correlation, semipartial correlations,
improvement in R-squared, squared partial correlations,
differences in standardized regression coefficients,
and Cohen's f-squared, for models fitted by `lm()`.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `betaLB` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaLB) with:

```r
if (!requireNamespace(package = "pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  utils::install.packages(pkgs = "pak")
}
pak::pkg_install(pkg = "jeksterslab/betaLB")
```

## Likelihood intervals

Fit once for the effect families, calibration types and confidence levels needed.
Extractors select stored results without refitting.

```{r likelihood-example}
fit <- stats::lm(formula = mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
out <- betaLB::LB(
  object = fit,
  effects = c("beta", "rsq"),
  type = c("mvn", "robust"),
  alpha = c(0.05, 0.10)
)
betaLB::BetaLB(object = out)
stats::confint(object = betaLB::RSqLB(object = out), type = "robust")
```

Scalar targets use profile-likelihood regions.
Multi-coefficient R-squared and block effects use conservative vector projection;
the output identifies this calibration and its dimension.
Robust calibration assumes independently sampled random regressors and finite
fourth moments. It does not supply fixed-regressor or clustered-data inference.

`out$intervals` contains every computed band and its endpoint statuses.
`out$diagnostics` retains numerical verification details.
An unverified endpoint is `NA`; no Wald endpoint is substituted.
Adjusted R-squared is an explicitly sample-size-dependent transformation,
and its interval can have a negative lower bound.
